title: xterm
cdHelp: change container; no argument or ~ goes home; follows references; "cd archive:/" changes disk
helpHelp: the built-in commands, and what /bin and /apps hold
noWindow: There is no window to close.
helpIntro: Walk CDMI namespaces. Paths are [1m[disk:]/container/object[0m; a trailing / means a container.
helpBackground: An application started here keeps the prompt until its window closes; end the name with & to get the prompt back at once, or press Ctrl-C.
helpKeys: Keys: Tab completes, Up/Down history, Ctrl-C interrupts, Ctrl-L clears, Ctrl-A/E/U/K/W edit. A command takes --help.
